newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end higher, could retreat Monday.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end higher, could retreat Monday.

text.p: 1645 GMT - Portuguese shares closed stronger, buoyed by forthcoming dividend payments and speculation on the final trading day for the April PSI20 futures contract.
*PSI20 index .PSI20 finished up 16.39 at 6,173.78 with total volume of around 9.2 billion escudos.
*PSI20 April futures were up 21 points at 6,186.
*Dealers said stocks which rose sharply today might retreat on Monday, depending on the mood on other European bourses.

*"We could see some falls on Monday as shares that rose on the prospect of dividends slip because they stop entitling investors to a dividend three days prior to the pay-out," said one trader. "New York's close will have an impact on Monday but a lot of today's gains were related to dividends or to corporate fundamentals," he added.
*Cimpor rose 65 escudos to 3,499 on volume of 596,142.
*BTA added 20 esc to 2,710 with 319,695 shares traded.
*BCP bucked the trend, shedding 15 esc to end at 2,500 on turnover of 303,401.
